patch.summary:
Thesis: Overlapping use cases, different tradeoffs — Flodesk and GetResponse share buyer workflows; choose based on documented strengths and limits.

Flodesk and GetResponse share buyer workflows; choose based on documented strengths and limits. Choose Flodesk only if your buying job matches “Design-led creator ESP with beautiful templates and subscriber-tier Lite / Pro / Everythin” rather than GetResponse's shape. Choose GetResponse only if your buying job matches “GetResponse is an AI-driven email marketing and lifecycle automation platform with newslet” rather than Flodesk's shape. Workflow advantage: Flodesk leans shared coverage; GetResponse leans ecommerce-email. Trade-off: you gain focus on one product's motion at the cost of the other's adjacent coverage — no universal winner.

Major differences:
- Buyer thesis: Overlapping use cases, different tradeoffs — Flodesk and GetResponse share buyer workflows; choose based on documented strengths and limits.
- Positioning: Flodesk is Design-led creator ESP with beautiful templates and subscriber-tier Lite / Pro / Everything plans.; GetResponse is GetResponse is an AI-driven email marketing and lifecycle automation platform with newsletters, automation workflows, landing pages, funnels.
- Company-size focus: Flodesk (micro, small-business) vs GetResponse (micro, small-business, mid-market).
- Workflow coverage skew: Flodesk-leaning — vs GetResponse-leaning ecommerce-email.
- Researched limits: Flodesk — Free plan is not a full forever-free ESP send tier; GetResponse — Starter limited to 1 custom automation workflow and capped AI generator uses.

Limitations — Flodesk: Free plan is not a full forever-free ESP send tier; Subscriber-tier pricing replaced legacy flat unlimited for new members; GetResponse: Starter limited to 1 custom automation workflow and capped AI generator uses; Free plan heavily limited after 14-day premium window (branding, LP visits, automation filters).

Poor-fit cases: Flodesk is a poor fit when that limitation bites: Free plan is not a full forever-free ESP send tier · GetResponse is a poor fit when that limitation bites: Starter limited to 1 custom automation workflow and capped AI generator uses · Avoid Flodesk if you actually need GetResponse's motion (GetResponse is an AI-driven email marketing and lifecycle automation platform wi)
